name: Clover House
source:
A cozy 14-day romance visual novel set in Ashihara. You stay at the Arai house on the lake and spend two weeks getting close to one of four adult women: Hana (29, writing a novel), Mio (26, calls dates 'training'), Ren (24, mailing her comic), or Sora (31, keeps the shop). 4 routes, played in the browser, free. Note: this game was made with AI assistance (code, art, and music).

[Description provided by the developer.]
